rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the single fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Part III amounts split into the peso comb and 2-slot centavo comb on the item's row (negative amounts stay blank, like every split-money sheet). Schedule 1 cells are single text cells and print the official text (1,234.50); on the printed sheet rows 1-3 (XM010) expose only Place, A, B and F, rows 4-8 expose Place, C, D and F, and the continuation omits the fixed rate column I for rows 1-8. Items 10 and 11 print the place names and the page 2 TIN comb the 14 TIN digits, from derived: keys of Form2200MDraft::to_print_field_map (the writer holds codes and a four-part TIN). Part IV (payment details) has no writer values. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Since #113 every value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
